title: Octopi in the Sky
description: Kites fly high at the Open Buzludzha Festival in the Balkan Mountains in Bulgaria. The festival began in 2021 as a campaign to preserve the decaying Buzludzha monument, a landmark that opened in 1981. The mountain the monument was built on is tied to key events in Bulgarian history, but has largely been neglected in the last three decades. However, the organizers of the festival see the future of the Buzludzha monument as a space for art, culture, and history, with the hopes of reusing it for educational and touristic purposes in the future.
translated_description: 在保加利亚巴尔干山脉举行的开放布兹卢贾节上，风筝高高飞扬。该节日始于2021年，旨在保护日渐破败的布兹卢贾纪念碑——这座地标性建筑于1981年落成。纪念碑所在的山峰与保加利亚历史上的重大事件紧密相连，但在过去三十年间基本被忽视。不过，该节日的组织者将布兹卢贾纪念碑的未来视为艺术、文化与历史的交汇空间，并希望未来能将其重新用于教育和旅游目的。
